sentences.zh: 次九隊，婦女二十人，冠車髻冠，服銷金藍衣，雲肩，佩綬，執孔雀幢，舞唱與前隊相和。

translations.literal: Next, the ninth formation: twenty women wearing carriage-topknot crowns, cut-gold blue robes, cloud collars, sashes, holding peacock banners, dancing and singing in harmony with the preceding formation.
translations.idiomatic: Next came twenty women in carriage-topknot crowns, cut-gold blue robes, cloud collars, and sashes, with peacock banners, dancing and singing in harmony with the preceding formation.

sentences.zh: 次十隊，婦女八人，冠翠花唐巾，服錦繡衣，執寶蓋，舞唱前曲。

translations.literal: Next, the tenth formation: eight women wearing emerald-flower Tang caps, brocade robes, holding treasure canopies, dancing and singing the preceding melody.
translations.idiomatic: Next came eight women in emerald-flower Tang caps and brocade robes, holding treasure canopies and dancing and singing the preceding melody.

sentences.zh: 次男子八人，冠鳳翅兜牟，披金甲，執金戟。

translations.literal: Next, eight men wearing phoenix-wing helmets, clad in golden armor, holding golden halberds.
translations.idiomatic: Next came eight men in phoenix-wing helmets, golden armor, and golden halberds.

sentences.zh: 次男子一人，冠平天冠，服繡鶴氅，執圭，齊舞唱前曲一闋，樂止。

translations.literal: Next, one man wearing a Level-Heaven crown, embroidered crane mantle, holding a scepter; all together danced and sang one stanza of the preceding melody, and the music stopped.
translations.idiomatic: Next came one man in a Level-Heaven crown, embroidered crane mantle, and scepter, who with the others danced and sang one stanza of the preceding melody, then the music stopped.

sentences.zh: 次婦女三人，歌《新水令》、《沽美酒》、《太平令》之曲終，念口號畢，舞唱相和，以次而出。

translations.literal: Next, three women sang through 《New Water Tune》, 《Buying Fine Wine》, and 《Peace Command》; when the slogans were finished they danced and sang in harmony and withdrew in order.
translations.idiomatic: Finally three women sang through 《New Water Tune》, 《Buying Fine Wine》, and 《Peace Command》; when the slogans were finished they danced and sang together and withdrew in order.

sentences.zh: 說法隊：引隊禮官樂工大樂冠服，並同樂音王隊。

translations.literal: The Dharma-Preaching Formation: the leading ritual officers, musicians, and Great Music caps and dress were all the same as the Music-King Formation.
translations.idiomatic: The Dharma-Preaching Formation: the leading ritual officers, musicians, and Great Music dress matched the Music-King Formation.

sentences.zh: 次二隊，婦女十人，冠僧伽帽，服紫禪衣，皂絳；

translations.literal: Next, the second formation: ten women wearing Sangha caps, purple Chan robes, and black cords;
translations.idiomatic: Next came ten women in Sangha caps, purple Chan robes, and black cords;

sentences.zh: 次婦女一人，服錦袈裟，余如前，持數珠，進至御前，北向立定，樂止，念致語畢，樂作，奏《長春柳》之曲。

translations.literal: next one woman in a brocade kasaya, the rest as before, holding prayer beads; advancing to before the throne, standing facing north, music stopped, congratulatory address finished, music began, playing 《Long Spring Willow》.
translations.idiomatic: then one woman in a brocade kasaya, otherwise as before, with prayer beads, advanced to the throne facing north, finished the congratulatory address as the music stopped, then the music resumed with 《Long Spring Willow》.

sentences.zh: 次三隊，男子三人，冠、服、舞蹈，並同樂音王隊。

translations.literal: Next, the third formation: three men; caps, dress, and dance all as in the Music-King Formation.
translations.idiomatic: Next came three men whose caps, dress, and dance matched the Music-King Formation.

sentences.zh: 次四隊，男子一人，冠隱士冠，服白紗道袍，皂絳，執麈拂；

translations.literal: Next, the fourth formation: one man wearing a recluse cap, white gauze Daoist robe, black cord, holding a fly-whisk;
translations.idiomatic: Next came one man in a recluse cap, white gauze Daoist robe, black cord, and fly-whisk;

sentences.zh: 從者二人，冠黃包巾，服錦繡衣，執令字旗。

translations.literal: two attendants wearing yellow wrapped caps, brocade robes, holding command-character banners.
translations.idiomatic: with two attendants in yellow wrapped caps and brocade robes bearing command-character banners.

sentences.zh: 次五隊，男子五人，冠金冠，披金甲，錦袍，執戟，同前隊而進，北向立。

translations.literal: Next, the fifth formation: five men wearing gold crowns, clad in golden armor and brocade robes, holding halberds; advancing with the preceding formation and standing facing north.
translations.idiomatic: Next came five men in gold crowns, golden armor, brocade robes, and halberds, who advanced with the preceding formation and stood facing north.

sentences.zh: 次六隊，男子五人，為金翅雕之像，舞蹈而進，樂止。

translations.literal: Next, the sixth formation: five men as images of golden-winged eagles, dancing forward; the music stopped.
translations.idiomatic: Next came five men costumed as golden-winged eagles, dancing forward, and the music stopped.

sentences.zh: 次七隊，樂工十有六人，冠五福冠，服錦繡衣，龍笛六，觱栗六，杖鼓四，與前大樂合奏《金字西番經》之曲。

translations.literal: Next, the seventh formation: sixteen musicians wearing Five Blessings crowns, brocade robes; six dragon flutes, six suona, four zhanggu; together with the preceding Great Music they played 《Gold-Letter Western Barbarian Sutra》.
translations.idiomatic: Next came sixteen musicians in Five Blessings crowns and brocade robes, with six dragon flutes, six suona, and four zhanggu, joining the preceding Great Music in 《Gold-Letter Western Barbarian Sutra》.

sentences.zh: 次八隊，婦女二十人，冠珠子菩薩冠，服銷金黃衣，纓絡，佩綬，執金浮屠白傘蓋，舞唱前曲，與樂聲相和，進至御前，分為五重，重四人，曲終，再起，與後隊相和。

translations.literal: Next, the eighth formation: twenty women wearing pearl Bodhisattva crowns, cut-gold yellow robes, tassels and sashes, holding golden stupa white parasols, dancing and singing the preceding melody in harmony with the music; advancing to before the throne, divided into five ranks of four each; when the piece ended they rose again in harmony with the following formation.
translations.idiomatic: Next came twenty women in pearl Bodhisattva crowns, cut-gold yellow robes, tassels and sashes, with golden stupa white parasols, dancing and singing in time with the music. They advanced to the throne in five ranks of four, and when the piece ended rose again in harmony with the following formation.

sentences.zh: 次九隊，婦女二十人，冠金翠菩薩冠，服銷金紅衣，執寶蓋，舞唱與前隊相和。

translations.literal: Next, the ninth formation: twenty women wearing gold-and-emerald Bodhisattva crowns, cut-gold red robes, holding treasure canopies, dancing and singing in harmony with the preceding formation.
translations.idiomatic: Next came twenty women in gold-and-emerald Bodhisattva crowns and cut-gold red robes, with treasure canopies, dancing and singing in harmony with the preceding formation.

sentences.zh: 次十隊，婦女八人，冠青螺髻冠，服白銷金衣，執金蓮花。

translations.literal: Next, the tenth formation: eight women wearing blue-snail-topknot crowns, white cut-gold robes, holding golden lotuses.
translations.idiomatic: Next came eight women in blue-snail-topknot crowns and white cut-gold robes, holding golden lotuses.

sentences.zh: 次男子八人，披金甲，為八金剛像。

translations.literal: Next, eight men clad in golden armor as images of the Eight Vajra Guardians.
translations.idiomatic: Next came eight men in golden armor costumed as the Eight Vajra Guardians.

sentences.zh: 次一人，為文殊像，執如意；

translations.literal: Next, one as the image of Manjusri, holding a ruyi scepter;
translations.idiomatic: Next came one as Manjusri, holding a ruyi scepter;

sentences.zh: 一人為普賢像，執西番蓮花；

translations.literal: one as the image of Samantabhadra, holding a Western lotus;
translations.idiomatic: one as Samantabhadra, holding a Western lotus;

sentences.zh: 一人為如來像；

translations.literal: one as the image of the Tathagata;
translations.idiomatic: and one as the Tathagata;

sentences.zh: 齊舞唱前曲一闋，樂止。

translations.literal: all together danced and sang one stanza of the preceding melody, and the music stopped.
translations.idiomatic: all together danced and sang one stanza of the preceding melody, then the music stopped.

sentences.zh: 次婦女三人，歌《新水令》、《沽美酒》、《太平令》之曲終，念口號畢，舞唱相和，以次而出。

translations.literal: Next, three women sang through 《New Water Tune》, 《Buying Fine Wine》, and 《Peace Command》; when the slogans were finished they danced and sang in harmony and withdrew in order.
translations.idiomatic: Finally three women sang through 《New Water Tune》, 《Buying Fine Wine》, and 《Peace Command》; when the slogans were finished they danced and sang together and withdrew in order.

sentences.zh: 凡吉禮，郊祀、享太廟、告謚，見《祭祀志》。

translations.literal: For auspicious rites—suburban sacrifice, offerings at the Imperial Ancestral Temple, and posthumous title announcements—see the 《Treatise on Sacrifice》.
translations.idiomatic: For auspicious rites—suburban sacrifice, offerings at the Imperial Ancestral Temple, and posthumous title announcements—see the 《Treatise on Sacrifice》.

sentences.zh: 軍禮，見《兵志》。

translations.literal: Military rites: see the 《Treatise on Military Affairs》.
translations.idiomatic: Military rites are covered in the 《Treatise on Military Affairs》.

sentences.zh: 喪禮五服，見《刑法志》。

translations.literal: Mourning rites and the five grades of mourning dress: see the 《Treatise on Penal Law》.
translations.idiomatic: Mourning rites and the five grades of mourning dress are covered in the 《Treatise on Penal Law》.

sentences.zh: 水旱賑恤，見《食貨志》。

translations.literal: Flood, drought, and relief: see the 《Treatise on Food and Goods》.
translations.idiomatic: Flood, drought, and relief measures are covered in the 《Treatise on Food and Goods》.

sentences.zh: 內外導從，見《儀衛志》。

translations.literal: Inner and outer escorts and attendants: see the 《Treatise on Ceremonial Guards》.
translations.idiomatic: Inner and outer escorts and attendants are covered in the 《Treatise on Ceremonial Guards》.
